metadata.title: A Gap Theorem For the Mobius Cross Energy
metadata.abstract: We prove that the critical value $2\pi^2$ is isolated for the Möbius cross energy of two-component links in the round three dimensional sphere $\mathbb{S}^{3}$. Specifically, there exists $\varepsilon_0>0$ such that any non-split, regular $H^2$ pair of curves with disjoint images, having vanishing first variation and energy at most $2\pi^2+\varepsilon_0$, must lie in the Möbius-reparametrization orbit of the standard Hopf link.

analysis.topic: 几何分析、几何 PDE 与几何流
analysis.workSummary: 作者证明圆三球面中两分支链环的 Möbius 交叉能量临界值 2π² 是孤立的：满足非分离、H² 正则、像不交与驻定条件的近临界链环必为标准 Hopf 链环的 Möbius 及重参数化像。
analysis.breakthrough: 把极小值结构推进到其附近全部驻定点的分类。
analysis.limitations: 结论需要驻定、非分离与正则性假设；不能理解成所有近极小链环都严格等同 Hopf 链环。 本次依据官方公告摘要分析，尚未核查正文和完整证明；未见披露仅指当前已读摘要与作者评论。
analysis.priorityReason: 能量间隙与几何刚性直接相关，适合与极小子流形的近等号问题对照。
